user: And I still have time to file, right?
answer:
Probably yes, but the deadline depends on the reason code, and some may be closing soon. TX-0401 is dated 2026-07-20, and today is 2026-09-15, so 57 days have passed. Windows run from the transaction date:

| Reason code | Window | Last day to file (approx.) | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Duplicate charge | 60 days | 18 Sep 2026 | **Open, 3 days left** |
| Unauthorised debit | 56 days | 14 Sep 2026 | **Closed** |
| Goods not received | 90 days | 18 Oct 2026 | Open |
| Service not rendered | 90 days | 18 Oct 2026 | Open |
| Card-not-present fraud | 120 days | 17 Nov 2026 | Open |

These dates are my calculation from the window lengths in our dispute rules. I haven't run an eligibility check yet, so I can't confirm any of them.

If this is a duplicate charge, or you're unsure, the deadline is the most urgent. Tell me what happened and I'll run the eligibility check right away. I won't open a dispute without your confirmation.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Customer security policy
## Card blocking
A customer may block a card immediately. Blocking is reversible for 30 days;
after that a replacement card must be ordered.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Glossary
## Chargeback window
The number of days, counted from the transaction date, during which a dispute
may be raised under a given reason code.
